title: Unit hero
description: A centred, airy first screen on a full-bleed backdrop of soft pastel light (mint, cyan, lilac) that fades to white at the top: a hairline announcement pill with an up-right arrow, a 64px regular-weight headline in three short lines, a slate subtitle and a black pill button. On phones the pill spans the width and the headline drops to 35px.
notes: media slot: the backdrop (a looping blurred-colour video in the original, 1440×532 cover); empty shows blurred pastel washes from glow, highlight and chart-1
height comes from its content, not the window
